intl.title: UMass Boston - International First-Year Student (deadlines, requirements, English proficiency, scholarships)

test_policy.notes: International first-year students can apply under the Test Optional plan without SAT/ACT scores (select 'Test Optional' on the application) for Early Action I, Early Action II and Regular Decision. Applicants who do submit scores may self-report them but must send official scores before orientation. Test-optional applicants can still qualify for merit scholarships. The page says the most competitive test-optional applicants have a recalculated high school GPA of 3.2 or higher.

requirements.notes: Apply with either the UMass Boston Application or the Common App. Required: $60 fee, official high school record/leaving certificate or graduation exam results (certified English translation; country-specific document lists apply), one academic recommendation letter from a school counselor and/or teacher, and a personal essay of about 500 words. The essay is also used for Honors College and scholarship consideration. Official English test scores must come from the testing agency.

deadlines.label: Early Action I (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: The page prints no year; taken as the current cycle. Test-optional applicants may use this round.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required for students whose native language is not English and who have not completed an English-based curriculum. Students from listed countries (e.g. Australia, Canada except Quebec, Ireland, Jamaica, Kenya, Nigeria, Singapore, Hong Kong, New Zealand) are exempt from the English proficiency test. Alternatives to TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo: SAT EBRW 480+ or ACT English plus Reading totaling 34+. Self-reported scores are not accepted for the English requirement. Provisional admission: an applicant who meets all other criteria but misses the TOEFL/IELTS minimum may be provisionally admitted and referred to the University Preparation ESL program; provisional admission is not offered for nursing, engineering or management applicants.

english.notes: Exams taken after Jan. 21, 2026; the page lists a minimum of '4' without naming the 1-6 scale.
'6.0+'. Official scores sent directly to UMass Boston Undergraduate Admissions.
Send via Duolingo by filtering for 'undergraduate' programs and selecting University of Massachusetts Boston.

cost.notes: International page, 'Estimated Expenses for the 2025 Academic Year' (taken as 2025-26): tuition and fees $41,488; room and board $13,298; books and personal/miscellaneous $4,294; required health insurance $3,487; total $62,567. In-state tuition is not given on this page.

aid.notes: First-year students are automatically considered for UMass Boston merit scholarships from their admissions application; international students with a 3.3 GPA or higher are considered for merit scholarships of up to $10,000 annually. Not available to students entering through partnership programs. The international page does not mention need-based aid, so that is left unconfirmed.
